module: Hardware telemetry utility module (loaded by require): turns the game controllers' information into telemetry data. For all devices: type, productName, vidpid, forceFeedback. For wheels (type 'wheel') it adds the official English name, GUID, force feedback axes, FFB sampling periods, hardware/firmware revisions, controls and their count by type.
notes: A wheel's English name only comes from an official table /settings/inputmaps/<lowercase vidpid>.json (isOfficialContentVPath): a mod table cannot provide the name.
A vidpid of 8 hexadecimal digits is uppercased (the first two groups of 4 give productId then vendorId); a symbolic identifier (e.g. 'XIDevice') keeps its case.
maxRawFfbUpdateRateHz = 1000000 / ff_sample_period; if the period is not a positive number, ffbSamplePeriodMicroseconds and the rate stay absent.

officialEnglishName.desc: Reads /settings/inputmaps/<pidVid>.json and returns displayName or name, only if this file belongs to the game's official content.

fromControllerInfo.desc: Converts a controller's info into a telemetry table. Non-wheels only keep type, productName, vidpid and forceFeedback; wheels additionally receive reportedName, deviceName, guid, hidSupported, ffbAxes, FFB periods, revisions, controls, controlCounts, productId, vendorId and maxRawFfbUpdateRateHz.

info.desc: Controller info (type, name, productName, vidpid, guid, ffbAxes, ff_sample_period, controls...).

englishName.desc: Official English name of the wheel, if known.

collect.desc: Applies fromControllerInfo to each controller (looking up the official English name of wheels).
